text:
The most likely cause is **D. Salmonella typhi**. A positive culture on Hektoen enteric agar points to a Gram-negative enteric pathogen, and Giardia lamblia is not grown on bacterial media (it is detected by stool antigen or microscopy), so the culture result favors Salmonella over Giardia. C. difficile is the classic antibiotic-associated diarrhea but does not grow on Hektoen, and Entamoeba is excluded for the same reason.

CONFIDENCE: 65
